title: Senior Systems Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Systems AnalystProvide technical expertise and analytical support throughout the lifecycle of products, applications, and technology initiatives. Partner closely with business stakeholders, analysts, developers, and testing teams to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into scalable, high-quality solutions. Contribute across various phases of the project lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development support, testing, implementation, and production support.  
The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a solid understanding of business processes and technology systems, and the capability to evaluate complex requirements, identify impacts across applications, and drive effective solutions.  
Major Accountabilities  
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:  

* Analyze business and system requirements to ensure proposed solutions meet functional and technical objectives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand needs, define requirements, and support the implementation of new products, services, and enhancements.
* Provide subject matter expertise and support for issue investigation and escalation activities.
* Develop conceptual solution designs, process flows, wireframes, and other analysis artifacts as required.
* Collaborate with development and testing teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Identify, prioritize, and recommend system and process improvements across applications and platforms.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing systems, processes, and integrations.
* Perform detailed requirements analysis and translate business needs into clear functional specifications.
* Facilitate requirements workshops, design reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Review solution designs to ensure alignment with business objectives and technical standards.
* Develop, review, and support execution of test plans, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing activities.
* Coordinate defect tracking, triage, and resolution activities.
* Work closely with developers, architects, and quality assurance teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Support audit, compliance, security, and regulatory requirements through appropriate documentation and controls.
* Create and maintain business, functional, technical, and process documentation.
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members when required.

Additional Functional Responsibilities  
Depending on the team or business area, responsibilities may also include:  

* Collaborating with business and technology teams to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and platform effectiveness.
* Acting as a liaison between business and technical teams for data analysis, reporting, compliance, operational support, and process improvement activities.
* Supporting data quality initiatives, reporting requirements, and business intelligence efforts.

Education  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

Knowledge & Experience  

* 7-9 years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, technology delivery, or a related discipline in Financial services domain
* Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business and system requirements.
* Ability to analyze complex business problems and translate them into practical solution recommendations.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles, testing processes, and change management practices. Hans on experience with Agile
* Experience working in cross-functional teams within a technology-driven environment.

Skills & Abilities  

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to solve complex business and technical problems.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and relationship-building abilities.
* Ability to facilitate discussions, build consensus, and influence outcomes across diverse teams.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Willingness to learn new technologies, business domains, and industry practices.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Lead Security Engineer to join our Vulnerability Research Development team. As a Lead Security Engineer, you will join a motivated engineering research team responsible for researching, developing, and delivering detection signatures for our vulnerability scanning products. This opening is your opportunity to work in the rapidly expanding field of computer security with a company with excellent customer ratings and outstanding growth rates.

**Responsibilities:**

* Research vulnerabilities in the areas of applications, operating systems, databases, TCP/IP protocols, network devices, and various services.
* Develop, test, and maintain high-quality detections to detect known vulnerabilities and 0-day threats.
* Research new and emerging technologies to identify vulnerabilities and exploits.
* Drive technical direction, prioritization, and execution of detection development initiatives.
* Collaborate with security researchers, product teams, and QA engineers to ensure the timely delivery of detection content.
* Research Zero-day vulnerabilities and actively attack vulnerabilities to deliver fast detection content within hours of vulnerability disclosure.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex vulnerability research and detection challenges.
* Stay up to date with the latest CVEs, advisories, and security intelligence feeds.
* Work with our Customer Support and Research teams to troubleshoot and triage customer issues such as false positives and false negatives.

**Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of industry experience in network and systems security.
* In-depth knowledge of TCP/IP, SSL, HTTP, FTP, SSH, DNS and others.
* Knowledge of OWASP top 10 and familiarity with other web-based attacks.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, Go).
* Ability to quickly analyse proofs-of-concept or exploits and translate them into accurate signatures.
* Experience with network analysis tools, and analysis of packet captures.
* Knowledge of different Databases (Oracle, DB2, etc.) and system Administration.
* Strong understanding of VPN, Firewalls, Intrusion detection systems (IDS), and security tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  
**Educational Qualification:** BE/B.Tech/MCA, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

**Additional Plus Competencies:**

* Experience with large-scale vulnerability management programs.
* Proficient with regular expressions and system administration.
* Demonstrated ability to drive strategic initiatives and independently own technical roadmaps.
* Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle, etc.).
* Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* OSCP, CISSP, or SANS GIAC certifications.

title: Market Risk Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Market Risk is an independent risk group within Risk Management, reporting to the Firm's Chief Risk Officer, which identifies, measures, monitors and controls market risk. Market risk management seeks to facilitate efficient risk/return decisions, reduce volatility in operating performance and ensure that the firm's market risk profile is transparent to senior management, the Board of Directors and regulators. The Market Risk Value at Risk and Capital Group is responsible for developing and delivering the operating model and framework for Basel market risk rule implementation in partnership with key stakeholder groups. In this role, you will support implementation, calculation, analysis, and reporting of market risk risk-weighted assets while partnering across Market Risk and Capital Management.

As a Market Risk Analyst within the Market Risk Value at Risk and Capital team, you will support the implementation, calculation, analysis, and reporting of market risk risk-weighted assets. You will help ensure the existing Basel regulatory framework and future regulatory requirements are properly implemented and maintained at the firm and legal entity levels. You will develop an understanding of the methodologies and inputs used for key market risk capital measures, and partner with Capital Management and other stakeholders on rule interpretation and controls. You will help manage controls and explain the risk-weighted asset measures by working with Market Risk management, middle office teams, business partners, quantitative research, and other groups.

Job responsibilities

* Verify inputs and outputs of risk-weighted asset calculations across multiple measures, and analyze and explain results
* Provide risk-weighted assets for quarterly regulatory reporting, the firm's internal stress testing process, and resolution and recovery reporting
* Perform scenario analysis and impact quantification on methodology and rule changes
* Implement and oversee end-to-end controls of capital measures by partnering with key stakeholders
* Identify operational risks and streamline processes to improve efficiency, explain capabilities, and strengthen controls
* Support the wider Market Risk organization on ad-hoc initiatives as needed

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2+ years of experience in Finance, Risk Management, or a related field
* Strong working knowledge of derivative products across one or more asset classes
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with a mindset on process enhancement and improvements
* Comfortable handling large datasets with strong Excel skills
* Self-motivated team player with the ability to research and resolve issues independently while working across teams to acquire needed information
* Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure, and deliver under tight deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Advanced degree
* Financial Risk Manager certification
* Knowledge of Basel market risk rules
* Experience with Tableau and Alteryx
* Working knowledge of Python and willingness to learn new toolsets

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Regional Tax Analyst
description:
**Company Description**

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose:**

Provide high-quality regional tax operations and compliance support across AMEA & JANZ, spanning indirect tax, withholding tax and corporate tax compliance. The role enables accurate, timely and controlled tax reporting; supports local entities and regional tax leadership in meeting statutory obligations; and strengthens tax governance, data quality, process standardization and audit readiness.

The role works within Group Tax policies, Global Syngenta Standards (GSM), applicable local legislation and approved tax-control frameworks. It does not replace local legal accountability or external adviser responsibilities, but coordinates, prepares, reviews and escalates matters to enable compliant local execution.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**1. Indirect Tax Compliance and Operations**

* Manage and support VAT/GST, sales tax, customs-related and other indirect tax compliance activities for assigned entities, including return preparation, review support, filings, payments, reconciliations and statutory reporting.
* Support accurate indirect tax accounting, input-tax-credit / refund monitoring, tax-code validation and reconciliation of tax returns to general ledger, sub-ledger and source data.
* Identify recurring compliance issues, data gaps and process-control failures; coordinate remediation with Finance Operations, business teams, IT and local tax contacts.
* Support indirect tax registrations, de-registrations, periodic reporting and local authority correspondence, under the direction of the responsible tax manager.

**2. Withholding Tax and Corporate Tax Compliance Support**

* Support country teams and regional tax leadership with corporate income tax compliance calendars, tax-return data collection, computations and filing coordination for assigned entities.
* Prepare or review recurring tax compliance workpapers, including taxable-income bridges, tax adjustments, withholding tax support, tax-payment schedules and supporting reconciliations, in accordance with local requirements and defined review protocols.
* Support quarterly and annual tax accounting activities, including current tax, deferred tax data inputs, effective tax rate analysis, tax provision support and balance-sheet reconciliations in partnership with Finance, Accounting and external advisers.
* Coordinate the timely collection, validation and retention of documentation required for local corporate tax returns, statutory accounts and tax disclosures.
* Monitor filing, payment and reporting deadlines; maintain a regional compliance tracker; and promptly escalate late, incomplete or high-risk items.

**3. Governance, Controls and Risk Management**

* Operate and continuously improve a consistent regional tax compliance calendar, evidence repository, review checklist and issue/escalation log across AMEA & JANZ.
* Implement Group Tax policies, regional tax frameworks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), process maps, risk-control matrices and desk-level instructions.
* Perform data-quality and completeness checks, maintain auditable support for key tax positions and ensure documentation is retained in accordance with internal and local requirements.
* Escalate material tax exposures, uncertain positions, significant filing delays, control deficiencies and changes in local legislation to regional tax leadership without delay.

**4. Audit, Assessment and Advisory Support**

* Coordinate information gathering and prepare supporting schedules for tax audits, assessments, investigations and statutory/external audits across direct and indirect taxes.
* Maintain audit trackers, manage document requests and support timely, consistent responses in collaboration with local finance teams, Group Tax, legal teams and external advisers.
* Support implementation of agreed remediation actions arising from audits, assessments, internal controls testing or process reviews.

**5. Process Excellence, Digital Enablement and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate tax compliance processes, including use of SAP data, Excel, Power Query, workflow tools and approved AI/digital solutions.
* Support system and process change initiatives by documenting tax requirements, testing impacts, validating master data and communicating revised tax procedures.
* Prepare regional dashboards, compliance status reports, risk summaries and management presentations for Group Tax and Finance leadership.
* Deliver practical training and regulatory-update sessions to finance and business stakeholders, promoting a consistent culture of tax compliance and timely escalation.

**Critical Success Factors and Key Challenges**

* Delivering complete, accurate and timely tax compliance across diverse jurisdictions, tax systems, languages and statutory calendars.
* Balancing regional standardisation with country-specific legal requirements, business models and operating realities.
* Translating high-volume finance and operational data into reliable tax reporting and defensible audit evidence.
* Building constructive working relationships with finance, business, IT, shared services, local management, external advisers and tax authorities.
* Prioritising competing tax, statutory-close and business deadlines while maintaining clear issue ownership and escalation.
* Driving sustainable process improvements without weakening controls or local accountability.

  
**Qualifications**

**Knowledge and Capabilities**

**Critical Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of corporate income tax, withholding tax, VAT/GST and broader indirect tax compliance concepts. Knowledge of transfer pricing, customs or tax accounting is advantageous.
* Experience supporting tax accounting and reporting, including current tax, deferred tax concepts, tax provisions, effective tax rate analysis and balance-sheet reconciliations.
* Operational knowledge of SAP or comparable ERP systems, general ledger processes, financial close and master-data dependencies.
* Advanced Excel capability; practical experience with data extraction, Power Query, macros or comparable automation tools. Familiarity with approved digital/AI tools is advantageous.
* Ability to prepare clear workpapers, SOPs, process flowcharts, control matrices, dashboards and executive-ready presentations.
* Strong written and verbal communication, analytical judgement, attention to detail and collaboration across a multi-cultural, multi-language regional environment.

**Critical Leadership Capabilities**

* Owns delivery and follows through: plans work rigorously, manages deadlines and raises risks early.
* Develops self and others: shares knowledge, provides clear guidance and builds tax-compliance capability in finance teams.
* Drives continuous improvement: challenges inefficient practices and converts insight into controlled, practical change.
* Works across boundaries: builds trust and influences stakeholders without direct authority.

**People Development**

* Build and sustain tax-compliance capability through coaching, training materials, knowledge-sharing sessions and documented procedures.
* Support a regional culture of ownership, control discipline, timely escalation and continuous learning.
* Contribute to a resilient team model through cross-training, succession support and effective handovers across the AMEA & JANZ portfolio.

**Experience Required**

* 5-10 years of relevant tax, finance or statutory compliance experience, preferably within a multinational, regional shared-service or advisory environment.
* Demonstrable experience in operational corporate tax and/or indirect tax compliance, tax accounting support, reconciliations and statutory reporting.
* Experience working with multiple jurisdictions and coordinating with internal stakeholders and external tax advisers.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end finance processes, internal controls and the link between transactional data, general ledger and tax reporting.
* Proven ability to manage a structured compliance calendar, resolve data and process issues, and communicate effectively with senior regional stakeholders.

**Minimum Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred. Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or Finance MBA.
* Professional tax qualification or postgraduate diploma in direct tax, indirect tax, international tax or statutory compliance is preferred.

  
**Additional Information**

***Note****: Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.*

To learn more visit: www.syngenta.com

Report progress on testing and problem resolution to appropriate parties. Devise improvements to current procedures and develops models of possible future configurations. Perform work flow analysis and recommends quality improvements.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

Creates test designs and performs test analysis on complex project requirements (as defined by the client). Coordinates with technical and business resources to identify and resolve complex issues or system defects discovered during the testing and design contingency plans as needed.
* Analyzes requirements necessary to design complex testing strategies (testing objective, methods of testing new functions, total time and resources required for the project, and the testing environment) for internal/external clients (i.e. technical and functional designs). * Works with stakeholders, business, developers and test analysts to develop more intricate test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing. Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation. * Maintains and administers procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance according to how they are applied in testing activities.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)About the Team:  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code.  
  
Roles and Responsibilities:  

* Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value.

- Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready.  

* Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize.
* Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not.
* Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.

- Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made.  

* Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus

what requires a platform build.  
- Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes.  

* Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today.

- Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling.  
  
All About You:  

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients.

- Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built.  

* Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage.
* Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus.

- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning.  

* Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon.
* Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker.  

* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped.
* Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Compliance with both Optum and client business unit requirements
* Support Workday Payroll configuration including earnings, deductions, taxes and payroll calculations
* Assist in payroll processing, payroll validation and reconciliation activities
* Troubleshoot and resolve payroll-related system and configuration issues
* Participate in Workday quarterly release reviews and payroll enhancements
* Support payroll integrations, EIBs and data loads
* Assist with change control and migration activities across Workday tenants
* Support application maintenance, security and access management
* Monitor interface and integration errors and perform issue resolution
* Monitor ServiceNow queue and provide timely updates to stakeholders
* Work directly with business users to gather requirements and document solutions
* Support payroll audits, compliance activities and process improvements
* Collaborate with HR, Benefits, Time Tracking and Finance teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 4+ years of Workday Payroll experience
* Hands-on experience with Workday Payroll configuration and support
* Experience with EIBs, reports and calculated fields
* Understanding of Workday business objects and security concepts
* Solid understanding of payroll processing, earnings, deductions and taxation concepts
* Proven solid analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proven excellent communication and collaboration abilities
* Willingness to work in US business hours

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Applications Development Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst** is an intermediate-to-senior level role responsible for leading and participating in the architecture, design, and full-lifecycle development of robust, scalable full-stack applications. This role focuses on modern distributed systems engineering using **Java/Spring Boot microservices**, **React.js frontends**, relational (**Oracle/SQL**) and document (**MongoDB**) databases, and containerized deployments across modern cloud environments (**Docker, Kubernetes, ECS**).

  
  

Additionally, the role requires working familiarity with **Generative AI (GenAI)** integrations to drive intelligent workflow automation, smart assistants, and next-generation engineering productivity.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  
  

**Full-Stack Architecture & Development**
-----------------------------------------

  
  

* **Backend & Microservices:** Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, resilient microservices and RESTful APIs using **Java (8/11/17+)**, **Spring Boot**, and modern enterprise integration patterns.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive single-page applications (SPAs) and user interfaces using **React.js**, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern state management libraries (Redux, Context API).
* **Database Design & Management:** Model, optimize, and manage both relational databases (**Oracle / SQL**) and NoSQL document stores (**MongoDB**), ensuring optimal query performance, indexing strategies, and data consistency.
* **Generative AI Integration:** Implement basic to intermediate **GenAI capabilities** (e.g., LLM API integrations, prompt design, RAG patterns, embeddings, and intelligent agents) into existing workflows and business applications.
  

  

**Cloud & Containerized DevOps**
--------------------------------

* **Containerization & Orchestration:** Package, deploy, and manage containerized workloads using **Docker**, **Kubernetes**, and container platforms such as **Amazon ECS / OpenShift / Enterprise Cloud Services**.
* **CI/CD & Automation:** Integrate code into automated CI/CD build and release pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton, Harness), enforcing code quality, automated testing, and security scanning.
  

  

**Systems Analysis, Design & Leadership**
-----------------------------------------

* Conduct feasibility studies, technical assessments, time/cost estimates, and IT planning to deliver technology solutions aligned with business strategy.
* Monitor and govern all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, system architecture, coding, unit/integration testing, and production rollout.
* Recommend and implement robust application security standards, role-based access controls (RBAC), and vulnerability remediations throughout the application lifecycle.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor junior engineers, fostering engineering best practices, code reviews, and technical documentation.
* Operate with high independence of judgment, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, product managers, and enterprise architecture teams.
* Proactively manage and assess risk, adhering strictly to firm policies, regulatory compliance, and governance frameworks.
  

  

**Professional Experience**
---------------------------

* **8-12 years** of professional software development experience in full-stack engineering and distributed systems.
* Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade **Spring Boot microservices** and **React.js** web applications.
* Strong hands-on experience in containerized deployments using **Docker**, **Kubernetes**, or **ECS**.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex architectural and business problems and deliver scalable solutions.
* Strong communication, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree / University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

We are building a cutting-edge, agentic AI platform designed to revolutionize the end-to-end credit risk model development lifecycle. By leveraging the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent workflows, we aim to augment our quantitative modelers, dramatically increasing their productivity, enhancing model governance, and accelerating the delivery of critical risk models.

Minimum BS/BSc/BTech degree in Computer Science Engineering or a related field

* Development and career opportunities

**Why You Will Love this Job**

To design, maintain, test and continuously improve the organization's Disaster Recovery and technical resilience capabilities by ensuring that critical systems, applications and infrastructure can be restored within agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) enabling uninterrupted business operations during disruptive events.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITES –
  
1. Disaster Recovery Planning & Documentation
  

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), recovery runbooks, standard operating procedures, and recovery handbooks for business-critical systems and applications.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of recovery procedures, dependencies, escalation paths, and ownership details.
* Ensure DR documentation remains current and aligned with infrastructure and application changes.

Recovery Strategy & Governance
  

* Define, document, and validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
* Assess recovery capabilities against business requirements and recommend improvements where gaps exist.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices related to Technical Disaster Recovery.

Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
  

* Facilitate and conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) across business units.
* Identify critical business services, application dependencies, infrastructure components, and recovery priorities.
* Document recovery requirements, acceptable downtime, and operational impact assessments.

DR Testing & Validation
  

* Plan, schedule, coordinate, and execute Disaster Recovery drills, tabletop exercises, failover tests, and full-scale recovery exercises.
* Validate recovery procedures and system recoverability against established RTO and RPO objectives.
* Document test results, identify gaps, track remediation activities, and ensure closure of action items.
* Produce management reports highlighting readiness status and improvement opportunities.

Infrastructure & Application Recovery Management
  

* Understand and document backup infrastructure, replication technologies, failover clustering, high-availability architectures, and cloud-based recovery environments.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Database, Security, Cloud, and Application teams to validate recovery processes.
* Ensure infrastructure & application recovery procedures are accurate, tested and recoverable during DR scenarios.
* Maintain inventory of critical systems, dependencies, recovery tiers, and recovery sequences.

Stakeholder Coordination
  

* Engage with technology and business stakeholders to gather information required for DR planning and testing.
* Coordinate periodic reviews to ensure recovery documentation remains current and aligned to system changes.
* Act as a central point of contact for DR program activities and recovery exercises.

Continuous Improvement
  

* Identify risks, gaps, and opportunities to strengthen organizational resilience.
* Recommend enhancements to recovery processes, automation capabilities, backup strategies, and recovery architectures.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory reviews related to Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity.

title: Client Relationship Support (Apprentice-12 Months)
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

**Role Purpose**

Credit & Capital Management (C&CM) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO)

The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors including Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts, and RMs in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all C&L tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.

The BCO Manager provides credit management support to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage and facilitates client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process. In discharging their duties the role holder must ensure a common, reliable, and predictable underwriting and lending process, that protects the business from exposure, whilst responding to clients borrowing needs. They are also responsible for co-ordination and completion of credit applications or renewals and risk escalation management. The role holder will report to the BCO Team Lead and will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and consistency of service for all customers.

The BCO manager will need to be an effective collaborator and skilled stakeholder manager, successfully navigating complex landscape to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
* Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders
* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk as required
* Strong execution and implementation ability.
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management

Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds

**Knowledge and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
* Corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
* Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances
* Strong commercial mindset
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization

**Additional Notes:**

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

**Pro-Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

**Additional Information**

The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time.All Apprentices engaged by the Bank will also be featured in NATS portal as an ‘Apprentice’. By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing.On completion of the one-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrollment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease.All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

our backend and frontend applications.

implementation level, own the maturity of our database and permission models, and set the

implementation targets that our R&D DevOps partners build against. You will sit alongside

our engineering team as the senior technical voice on infrastructure and security, with real

decision-making authority and the expectation that you use it in consultation with the team.

* Hands-on experience with AI infrastructure, whether professional or through personal projects

* Experience standing up and operating cloud inference environments
* Familiarity with model-serving platforms and inference runtimes
* Experience designing or deploying production AI agent systems
* Experience implementing tracing, evaluation, and observability for AI agents

title: Lead Technology Risk Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Technology Risk AnalystOverview  
  
The Lead Technology Risk Analyst within the Program Controls, Operations & Modernization (ProCOM) Office is responsible for leading the implementation and execution of technology risk management, governance, controls, and operational resilience programs across Mastercard's technology organization. This role partners closely with technology, product, engineering, security, and business teams to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate technology risks while strengthening control effectiveness and operational maturity.  
  
The position serves as a key leader in advancing ProCOM's mission to deliver scalable governance, risk management, production readiness, and operational excellence capabilities. Through risk assessments, governance oversight, control monitoring, operational intelligence, and continuous improvement initiatives, this role helps ensure technology products and platforms are delivered with resiliency, reliability, and compliance while enabling informed risk-based decision making. The Lead, Technology Risk Manager plays a critical role in translating strategic risk objectives into actionable programs, measurable outcomes, and sustainable operational practices.  
  
Role  

* Lead the execution of technology risk management programs and initiatives across products, platforms, services, and technology domains.
* Facilitate technology risk identification, assessment, treatment, monitoring, and escalation processes to ensure risks are proactively managed and appropriately governed.
* Drive adoption of technology risk frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures across engineering and technology teams.
* Partner with product, engineering, operations, security, and risk stakeholders to evaluate control effectiveness and identify opportunities to strengthen operational resilience.
* Lead risk assessments, control reviews, operational readiness evaluations, and governance activities supporting strategic initiatives and technology changes.
* Monitor technology risk indicators, control metrics, issue remediation activities, and operational performance trends to identify emerging risks and systemic concerns.
* Develop executive-ready reporting, risk summaries, governance materials, and operational insights that support leadership decision-making.
* Coordinate technology risk governance forums and ensure action items, decisions, and risk mitigation activities are appropriately tracked and executed.
* Support audit, regulatory, compliance, and assurance activities by coordinating evidence collection, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
* Identify recurring operational issues, control gaps, and process weaknesses and lead initiatives to improve risk management effectiveness.
* Drive automation and process improvements that reduce manual effort, enhance governance capabilities, and improve data quality and reporting accuracy.
* Leverage operational and risk data to develop meaningful insights, trends, and recommendations that support proactive risk management.
* Provide guidance and subject matter expertise to stakeholders on technology risk, governance, resilience, and control practices.
* Mentor and support team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

  
All About You  

* Experience in technology risk management, operational risk, governance, controls, cybersecurity, audit, compliance, technology operations, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of technology risk frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, control environments, and operational resilience principles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and communicate technology and operational risks in a clear and business-focused manner.
* Experience leading risk assessments, control reviews, issue management activities, governance processes, and remediation efforts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex operational and technical situations and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, governance materials, dashboards, and risk intelligence presentations.
* Ability to analyze operational, risk, and performance data to identify trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across business, technology, product, and control functions.
* Knowledge of regulatory expectations, audit practices, operational resilience frameworks, and technology governance principles.
* Experience driving process improvement, workflow optimization, automation, and modernization initiatives.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical and risk concepts into meaningful business insights.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, operate independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and building scalable risk and governance capabilities.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead Security Engineer | Platform
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end\-to\-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
As **Lead Security Engineer \| Platform**, you will be the subject matter expert for the client's endpoint, application control, email, and web\-edge security platforms and will lead the Network and Identity Security Engineers.**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK\-based, security\-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
Responsibilities:
* Act as a subject matter expert in endpoint protection and XDR, application allowlisting, email security gateways, and web\-edge platforms (WAF, DDoS, and DNS).
* Define and maintain secure configuration baselines and hardening standards aligned to vendor best practices and client policy.
* Review platform configurations, using exports released through the UK service boundary, and recommend improvements.
* Design platform changes and prepare complete change packages, including implementation, test and back\-out plans, for implementation by UK\-based personnel.
* Assess application control exception and policy exclusion requests and provide risk\-based recommendations for governance approval.
* Analyse platform reporting (endpoint coverage and drift, malware trends, email threat trends, application control activity) and produce monthly reports and recommendations.
* Assess the coverage of security log feeds in the client's retained SIEM against the logging design, and recommend corrective actions and improvements to detection use cases.
* Track vendor support lifecycles, identify end\-of\-support risk and produce upgrade plans.
* Provide platform expertise and forensic\-readiness input (runbooks, evidence sources, playbooks) to support the UK SOC and incident response partner.
* Provide advisory support to incident management when requested, including during major incidents.
* Contribute platform content to monthly service reports and maintain platform diagrams and documentation.
* Lead, allocate and quality\-review the work of the Network and Identity Security Engineers.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client\-facing delivery excellence.


Qualifications:
* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vendor certification in at least one enterprise endpoint/XDR or SIEM platform (e.g. Palo Alto Cortex, Microsoft SC\-200, CrowdStrike, IBM QRadar, Splunk).
* GIAC GCIH/GCIA, CompTIA CySA\+ or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.


Essential skills:
* Strong knowledge of EDR/XDR and anti\-malware platforms (e.g. Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trellix).
* Application allowlisting and device control (e.g. Carbon Black App Control, Airlock Digital, WDAC).
* Email security gateways (e.g. Cisco Secure Email, Proofpoint, Mimecast).
* Web application firewall, DDoS and DNS protection services (e.g. F5, Cloudflare, Akamai).
* Understanding of SIEM log onboarding and detection use cases (e.g. QRadar, Splunk, Sentinel).
* Producing secure configuration baselines, design documentation and change packages.
* Incident response lifecycle (NIST SP 800\-61\) and ITIL change and incident management.
* Scripting and data analysis (PowerShell, Python, KQL, AQL or SPL) for reporting.


Desired skills:
* Digital forensics and forensic\-readiness experience (e.g. EnCase, FTK, Magnet AXIOM) and chain\-of\-custody practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Awareness of OT security constraints.


Experience:
* 8\-12 years in security engineering or operations, including 3\+ years in a lead role across endpoint, gateway and logging platforms.
* Experience leading and quality\-reviewing the work of other engineers.
* Experience supporting managed security services in regulated or CNI environments.

title: Core Operations - Senior Manager
description:
**About the role**

We are hiring an **Officer** to support the end\-to\-end business analysis, deployment and operational transition of the **Direct Custody model** for **Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands \& Germany and other T2S markets.** The role will support the translation of complex client, market and infrastructure requirements into clear business requirements, process documentation, test scenarios and implementation deliverables across securities settlement, cash and FX support, corporate actions, income, reconciliation and client/account setup.


The successful candidate will operate as a business analyst within the Direct Custody Business Design \& Deployment team, supporting senior workstream leads and partnering with Product, Operations, Technology, Vendors, Market Infrastructures and Control Functions. Following implementation, the role may support subsequent market launches or transition into the relevant BAU Direct Custody operations.


**Why this role is important to us**

State Street is progressing a strategic transformation from sub\-custodian arrangements to direct market participation across key markets. Project requires a coordinated operating model across T2S direct markets, non\-direct and sub\-custodian routes, multiple client archetypes, account structures and market\-specific exception mechanisms.


This role is critical to:


* **Supporting controlled direct\-market implementation** through accurate business analysis, requirements documentation, testing and operational\-readiness execution.
* **Supporting a scalable and integrated service model** across settlement and market\-facing activities, while aligning upstream processing with the existing operating model.
* **Documenting client and market\-specific complexity** by distinguishing standard custody processing from exceptions requiring operating\-model, technology and control closure.
* **Building sustainable internal capability** through documented processes, training, knowledge transfer and reusable implementation artefacts.

**Key responsibilities (Direct Custody aligned)**

* **Market, Client and Account\-Structure Analysis**
* Analyse market rules, clients, transaction volumes, operating locations and service requirements across Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and associated non\-direct routes.
* Gather and analyse requirements for the different client archetypes and local market participants.
* Document operational requirements for Cash \& Securities Account structures.
* Review existing roles and responsibilities and identify functional, process, control and ownership deltas against the target Direct Custody model.
* **Target Operating Model and End\-to\-End Process Design**

* Prepare and maintain business requirements, user stories, process maps, functional clarifications and traceability across business, technology and vendor deliverables.
* Analyse vendor and application capabilities, document functional and integration gaps, and support definition of remediation or target\-state solutions.

* Develop detailed test scenarios and test cases covering standard processing, client/market variants, exceptions, controls and end\-to\-end integration.
* Execute or coordinate system integration testing, market testing and user acceptance testing, including defect logging, remediation validation, retesting and regression testing.
* Maintain business\-readiness assessments across operating procedures, staffing, access, static data, connectivity, controls, reporting and contingency arrangements.
* Prepare evidence and status reporting to support go\-live and client\-conversion decisions, risk assessment and stakeholder sign\-off.
* Support implementation, stabilisation and structured handover into the Direct Custody BAU organisation.
* **Risk, Controls, Compliance and Operational Resilience**
* Document risk, compliance and governance requirements within the target operating model and solution deliverables.
* Support operational resilience and business\-continuity readiness, including critical process documentation, recovery requirements and BCP knowledge transfer.
* Assist with business\-function, control and organisational\-framework setup, risk assessments and evidence requirements.
* Coordinate access, security and identity\-governance requirements, including role mapping, approvals and segregation\-of\-duties evidence.
* Track regulatory, market\-infrastructure and connectivity requirements through to closure before implementation.
* **Procedures, Training and Knowledge Transfer**
* Review existing procedures and Business Process Maps to determine applicability and gaps for new Direct Custody functions.
* Draft and maintain market\- and application\-specific SOPs, control procedures, operating guides and process documentation aligned to the Target Operating Model.
* Prepare and support delivery of training on market structures, applications, operating processes, exceptions and controls for implementation, BAU and BCP teams.
* Support structured handover, cross\-training and maintenance of reusable artefacts for future Direct Custody market launches.
* **Stakeholder Coordination and Delivery Support**
* Coordinate assigned activities and provide analytical, documentation and subject\-matter support to senior workstream leads and project resources.
* Partner across Product, Operations, Technology, vendors, Market Agents, Risk, Compliance, Client Service and other internal stakeholders.
* Prepare workshop materials, capture requirements, decisions and actions, and communicate operational matters clearly to stakeholders.
* Escalate business\-design and readiness issues promptly, ensuring risks, dependencies and decisions are transparent and tracked to resolution.
* Promote standardisation, automation, operational resilience and continuous improvement across the regional and global Direct Custody operating model.
  

**Operational analytics and reporting**

* Build and maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational\-readiness milestones.
* Maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational\-readiness milestones.
* Produce concise workstream reporting on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, remediation actions and readiness status.
* Support capacity, footprint and workforce planning for phased market delivery and transition into BAU operations.
* Use defect, exception and post\-implementation metrics to support root\-cause analysis and identify opportunities for control enhancement, process standardisation and automation.
  

**Qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Technology or a related discipline; a Master's degree, MBA or relevant professional qualification is advantageous.
* Typically, 6\-9 years of experience in securities services, custody, post\-trade operations, business analysis, testing or transformation delivery.

* Practical understanding of T2S, European CSD/ICSD models, Dedicated Cash Accounts, settlement messaging, market cut\-offs and exception management.

title: Analyst US High Grade Strategy
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

As an Analyst US High Grade Strategy within the US Credit Strategy team, you will work end to end on multiple time sensitive deliverables which include day\-to\-day monitoring of US Credit\-relevant sectors/issuers and market developments, staying on top of catalysts, flows, technicals, and fundamentals.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Working end to end on multiple time sensitive deliverables which include day\-to\-day monitoring of US Credit\-relevant sectors/issuers and market developments, staying on top of catalysts, flows, technicals, and fundamentals.
* Conducting detailed analyses and deep\-dive research of key market trends which include assessing news, macro developments, and industry trends for implications to spreads, ratings, and capital structures.
* Build and maintain financial models and key credit/coverage metrics; use outputs to support strategy discussion on risk, valuation, and relative value.
* Write concise, client\-ready research notes and contribute to broader thematic/sector pieces with timely market commentary.
* Present findings clearly (written and verbal) and support market and positioning views and perspectives in internal debates and client\-facing conversations under time pressure.
* Monitor earnings and translate takeaways into a clear strategy/credit view
* Develop, maintain, and enhance quantitative/econometric models and frameworks for forecasting, scenario analysis, and market/policy interpretation relevant to Credit Portfolios.
* Manage, clean, and analyze large datasets using tools such as Python (and other research toolkits) to produce charts, tables, and publication\-ready outputs.
* Perform valuation and relative value analysis across issuers, curves, and structures, with clear conclusions and actionable framing.
* Contribute to automation and process improvement, emphasizing data integrity and reproducibility across recurring publications and templates.
* Prepare Excel charts, Word documents, and PowerPoint materials for publications, client conferences, and recurring chart books/data visualizations and collaborate with strategists, economists, and global research teams; support investor events/webinars/conferences as needed.

  

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities**


* 1\-3 years in Research, Banking, or another rigorous analytical role; strong interest in markets.
* Strong quantitative/econometric foundation (e.g., multiple regression) and comfort working with macro/market data.
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; fluency with AI\-enabled tools to accelerate analysis.
* Coding skills to manipulate data and perform statistical analysis using tools such as Python (plus Eviews/VBA where relevant).
* Strong writing and presentation skills; clear, concise communication under time pressure.
* Strong organization, prioritization, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a deadline\-driven team.
* Proficiency with Bloomberg and familiarity with common financial market data sources/conventions (e.g., Bloomberg/Haver/CEIC).
* Experience with advanced econometric/statistical techniques, machine learning, and/or natural language processing for research workflows.
* Strong MS Office skills (Word/PowerPoint) and experience producing publication\-quality materials.
* Master's degree or above in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field from reputed institutions.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. title: Fund Services.Operations Analyst
description:
**About Citco:**

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front\-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.


**About the Team \& Business Line:**

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.


  
**Your Role:**

* Coordinate month\-end collateral interest process between counter\-parties
* Instruct collateral and treasury transfer payments via SWIFT
* Prepare expense payments in Æxeo Treasury
* Agree and process over\-the\-counter (OTC) payments on behalf of clients
* Reviewing vendor platforms (such as Omgeo CTM, Traiana, Markit Trade Manager), PB matching portals and recaps on Trade Date
* Responsible for listed securities settlements via Prime Broker platforms, ensuring trades are pre\-matched and subsequently settle on the market between the counterparty and PB
* You will be responsible for the review, exception processing, break escalation/resolution and subsequent affirm/confirm of trade between the client and executing counterparty.
* You will assist with training and development of junior members of the team
* May work on special projects as needed
* Work with internal stakeholders/client in a professional manner to resolve any open issues

  
**About You:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or other quantitative subjects
* Knowledge of various different fund types
* Strong Customer Service and analytical and problem solving skills
* Committed team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Detail focused with the ability to multi\-task
* Ability to learn new systems and source information from numerous systems
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Adaptive, flexible professional style, capable of working in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Strong computer skills, with proficiency in Excel and Word, and aptitude to learn new skills
* Ability to organize, prioritize tasks and work in a deadline\-oriented environment
* Comfortable communicating with clients and counterparties via e\-mail and phone
* Experience/exposure to a cash settlements role not essential but would be of benefit
* Experience/exposure to ISDA Bi\-Lateral agreements and the collateral process not essential but would be of benefit
* Experience/exposure to financial instruments such as equities, bonds, equity swaps, FX, futures and OTC products not essential but would be of benefit.

**Skills and Behaviors You'll Bring:**  

  

**Building Future Readiness** – Demonstrates resilience by adapting well to change and is committed to improving knowledge and skills for the future.
  

  

**Delivering Client Excellence** – Partners with internal and external clients to understand needs, develop solutions and deliver an excellent client experience.
  

  

**Problem Solving \& Decision Making** – Demonstrates Data Literacy to analyze issues, identify practical solutions, and make informed decisions while taking responsibility for outcomes.
  

  

**Building Relationships** – Builds trusted relationships in an inclusive way. Positively influences outcomes while strengthening working relationships.
  

  

**Emotional Intelligence** – Demonstrates self\-awareness in identifying emotions, understanding triggers, and choosing appropriate behavior for the circumstance. Recognizes when biases may be impacting decisions. Seeks to understand and empathizes with others’ emotions and perspectives.
  

  

**Managing Risk** – Commits to protecting Citco by being aware of internal and external risks, thinking ahead to understand how those risks could affect people, processes or outcomes. Takes proactive steps using sound judgement to support safe and effective decision making. Values and promotes a strong risk culture.
  

  

**AI \& Digital Literacy** – Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-powered tools and evolving digital technologies to enhance productivity, efficiency, and quality of work
  

  

**Learn more** about Citco's expected skills, behaviors, and the hiring process at *Careers FAQ*  

  

**Our Benefits**  



Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.


We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.


Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

title: IT Security Analyst
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a hands\-on security professional to own the security of our internal systems, enterprise data and client data. You'll protect our infrastructure, investigate incidents, run regular security audits and build a security\-aware culture across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Secure internal systems, servers, cloud environments and networks against unauthorized access and threats

Implement and manage privileged access (PAM), role\-based access controls and least\-privilege policies

Secure logins and identities through MFA, SSO, password policies and account lifecycle management

Deploy and manage endpoint security (EDR/antivirus, device management, patching) across all laptops, desktops and mobile devices

Conduct security investigations, monitor logs and alerts, and perform root\-cause analysis of incidents

Run periodic security checkups, including vulnerability assessments, configuration reviews and access audits

Lead incident response for data breaches: contain, mitigate, document and prevent recurrence
